Welcome to wART Radio!      
    We were located in downtown Marshall, NC -- and we used to broadcast from a little red caboose at the end of town -- until the flood of 9/27/2024.  The  French Broad River rose some 26 feet that day, smashing into our caboose and sending it some 300 feet down the street. Below are photos of the historic flood that destroyed Marshall, NC, but not our spirit.     
 
    Our website allows you to check out Who We Are, our Program Schedule, & to Listen Live anytime!
